items.title: Costco (COST) Lifts Dividend After Strong 2026 Results And $7.5 Billion 2027 Plan
items.summary: Costco Wholesale (NasdaqGS:COST) reported strong fiscal 2026 results, reinforcing management's confidence in the warehouse retailer's growth plans. The board approved a higher regular dividend for shareholders, signalling a larger ongoing cash return from the business. Management outlined a major capital spending plan for fiscal 2027 focused on opening new warehouses and expanding capacity.
